params.body:
## Why

`docs/bedrijfsregels/bronnen/beslissingen.md` was the one file every proposal appended to: a decision is a `#### <anchor>` section, and five open pull requests (526, 527, 531, 533, 538) all added one at the end. Same last line, guaranteed conflict, the same way findings collided before they were split one file each on 2026-09-15.

## What changes

- **One file per decision**: `docs/bedrijfsregels/bronnen/beslissingen/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<anchor>.md`, frontmatter `anchor`, `titel`, `datum`, `door` (Shane, Ilse, Frederik), `bron` (mail, work session, acceptance test V-n), body = the quoted decision and the why. A `README.md` in the folder says how to add one (one new file, no shared file touched).
- **Citations unchanged**: `klant:beslissingen#<anchor>` still works; `bin/rules-sources.php` resolves the anchor by scanning the folder (frontmatter `anchor`). The footnote in `bin/rules-page` now links the decision's own title and file.
- **Old file still read** while a proposal in flight appends to it; the same anchor in both fails with both file names ("keep the one in the folder and remove the section from the file"). Two files claiming one anchor, a missing frontmatter key, a `datum` that is not yyyy-mm-dd, a `door` that is not one of the three, or a file not named `<datum>-<anchor>.md` fail as well, cited or not.
- **Migrated** the eight existing sections (`v-4`, `v-5`, `wie-mag-bieden`, `originele-eigenaar-overnamedocumenten`, `lijsten-2026-09-17`, `chassisnummer-een-actieve-fiche`, `open-punten-2026-09-17`, `inloggen-als-kiest-een-gebruiker`); all were recorded on 2026-09-17, so no date had to be guessed. The old `beslissingen.md` is removed.
- `00-inleiding.md`: the table row and the "Een bron toevoegen" paragraph point at the folder.

## Tests

`RulesSourcesTest`: a decision anchor resolves from the folder (fixture and the real folder), an anchor in both the old file and the folder fails with the exact message while an anchor only in the old file still resolves, and a malformed decision file is named in the problems.

`vendor/bin/phpunit --filter 'RulesSourcesTest|RulesIdentityTest|RulesCoverageTest|RulesDocsBuildTest'`: OK (17 tests, 64 assertions). `bin/rules-sources`: 872 regels, geen problemen. `bin/rules-page`: written.
params.title: Business rules: one file per decision, so proposals stop colliding
